response.sql: WITH team_avg AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(CAST(l AS REAL) / g) AS avg_loss_rate FROM manager_half WHERE g > 53 GROUP BY team_id) SELECT AVG(avg_loss_rate) AS avg_of_team_avgs FROM team_avg;

assumptions.assumption: Each manager_half row is one stint, and 'pass the 53-game mark' means g > 53 (strictly more than 53 games).
Teams are identified by team_id, and l is divided by g as REAL so the division is not truncated to an integer. NULL l or g values produce NULL rates, which AVG skips.
